product_metadata.title: Big Dot of Happiness Adult 60th Birthday - Gold - Birthday Party Favor Popcorn Treat Boxes - Set of 12
features: Adult 60th Birthday Favor Popcorn Treat Boxes INCLUDES 12 Adult 60th Birthday party favor boxes. Adult 60th Birthday treat boxes are perfect for any event. The gold theme is great for a birthday party.

Adult 60th Birthday party favor popcorn treat boxes SIZE 5.75 inches tall x 3.5 inches square at the top. The unique design and large size makes these 12 sixtieth birthday popcorn boxes a must-have for any birthday party.

POPCORN BOX PARTY SUPPLIES: Adult 60th Birthday popcorn boxes will hold a variety of party food. Fill them with sweet treats or salty snacks. Popcorn, caramel corn, candies and other goodies will look amazing on your candy buffet with these gold favor boxes.

PREMIUM PARTY FAVOR BOXES: Adult 60th Birthday party treat boxes are professionally printed on heavy-duty cardstock paper with a photo-like shine. They are hand-folded and individually inspected, then carefully packaged. Popcorn boxes will arrive flat. Easy assembly is required.

MADE IN AMERICA: Adult 60th Birthday - Gold - Birthday Party Favor Popcorn Treat Boxes are designed and manufactured at our Wisconsin facility using materials that are Made in America. Our Treat Boxes use a No-Mess Glitter Print: Our popcorn boxes are designed with a printed image of glitter, eliminating glitter flake while maximizing bling effect!
